result.stdout:
Info: 🚼 MollyCoddle Online. (1.4.3.0)
MollyCoddle, for when you cant let the babbers code on their own....
Parameter help for MollyCoddle

MollyCoddle -debug -dir -disabled -fix -formatter -primaryRoot -version -rulesfile -temppath -warnonly -addrulehelp 

-debug Set to a debug string to write out additional logging and debugging information.
-dir 
-disabled If Disabled is set the mollycoddle will not execute but will return 0 instead.
-fix If set, then Mollycoddle will attempt apply a fix to resolve discovered violations.
-formatter If set to azdo then azure build pipelines formatting will be used, otherwise plain text output.
-primaryRoot 
-version If set then will replace {{VER}} in the rules loading path or file with the string value passed.  Defaults to not used.
-rulesfile Path to either a mollyset or molly rules file.
-temppath Working directory for molly, and cache location. Supports environment variables.
-warnonly If set then MollyCoddle will return zero even if faults are found, but the faults will be outputted.
-addrulehelp If set then MollyCoddle will output hyperlinks in the error messages.
